stories.headline: £140m winter boost includes 40 extra EMAS ambulances
stories.body: The government is funding 14 urgent care schemes in England ahead of winter, including £6.35m for 40 more double-crewed ambulances at East Midlands Ambulance Service and £12m for a replacement ambulance hub in Shrewsbury.
stories.why: More crews on the road in the East Midlands this winter, though the money is spread across just 14 schemes.

stories.headline: Royal College of Paramedics holds first mental health conference
stories.body: The College’s inaugural mental health conference runs in Cheltenham on Tuesday 20 October and is open to students, with Simon Weston CBE giving the keynote and sessions on patient mental health care and paramedic wellbeing.
stories.why: Mental health is a growing part of the job, and of looking after ourselves. Watch for the talks being shared afterwards.

stories.headline: Aspiring paramedic, 15, helps save a man’s life
stories.body: A 15-year-old from Mansfield Woodhouse who had done a CPR course with EMAS started compressions on a 75-year-old man in cardiac arrest and kept going until crews arrived. He now runs free CPR sessions for young people.
stories.why: Bystander CPR is the link crews depend on. Community training is paying off, and a future colleague is already making a difference.

stories.headline: Cyclist backs CPR push after bystanders saved him
stories.body: A cyclist survived a roadside cardiac arrest near Brands Hatch after passers-by gave more than 20 minutes of CPR. KSS Air Ambulance ran public CPR and defibrillator sessions for Restart a Heart Day.
stories.why: Twenty minutes of bystander CPR bought the time crews needed. That is the case for public training in one story.
